title: Unsupported kwarg passed to http.parse_cookie
detail: The function forwards all kwargs, including 'cls', to http.parse_cookie, which does not accept this argument. This will raise a TypeError when 'cls' is supplied.

title: Unsupported kwarg passed to http.parse_cookie
detail: The request.cookies property passes a 'cls' kwarg to parse_cookie, which now delegates to http.parse_cookie that does not accept 'cls', causing a TypeError.

title: Potential AttributeError when host_with_port is None
detail: If the URL has no explicit port, `host_with_port` remains None. The subsequent check `host_with_port.endswith(host)` will raise an AttributeError because None has no `endswith` method. This occurs on the added lines 854-858.
note: Near the bug, but about host_with_port being None, not the planted flip.
